bullets.text: As an individual contribution to a supervised capstone, ran and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided records, and edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied notebook procedures validating pandas merges through duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and analyzed Matplotlib visualizations of how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to supervised research, wrote Python functions for parsing provided public policy records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, validated pandas merges of provided metadata tables with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
